summary: Li Bang International (Cayman FPI) filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its wholly-owned PRC subsidiary, Jiangsu Li Bang Intelligent Technology, and three individual sellers of Suzhou Yufengyuan Food Distribution terminated their equity transfer agreement by mutual Termination Letter dated October 8, 2026, effective that same day. The deal, originally signed March 2, 2026 and replaced April 17, 2026, will not close. The parties expressly confirmed the agreement was not final and binding, released each other from all obligations, and did not survive the breach-liability provision. No price, stake, premium, or advisor was disclosed. Watch for any renewed transaction or dilution from the F-3 shelf.
